create_memory_planning_game_env: create a MemoryPlanningGame environment with a configurable maze size and reward settings
reset_episode: reset the MemoryPlanningGame environment to start a new episode with randomized node labels
step_agent_action: step the agent by taking an Up, Down, Left, Right, or Collect action in the maze
run_random_agent: run a random agent by calling take_random_action to sample actions from the environment
visualize_maze: draw and visualize the maze grid showing agent position, goal, and episode reward
